members.reason: Independent review did not uphold this version: [{"field": "operative_clauses[EO:12785#whole].first_end and whole_order_end (date 1993-09-30, actor EO:12869, mechanism express_revocation_of_parent_naming_this_amendment)", "claim_says": "The inserted date December 31, 1992 is 'unsupported as an actual end' because EO 12687 allows earlier extension and no held source records the committee's lapse; the end is EO 12869's revocation effective 1993-09-30.", "source_says": "EO 12687 sec. 4(b) as amended by this order reads that the Committee 'shall terminate on December 31, 1992, unless sooner extended.' That is a self-executing sunset: the committee ended on that date by law unless an extension issued, and lapse needs no separate record. The claim's own search of EO 12687's number (EO 12687, 12741, 12785, 12869 and the OLRC note at 20 U.S.C. 1221) found no extension beyond 1992. EO 12869 Sec. 4 revokes EO 12687 among orders 'which established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed', which corroborates the lapse. The amendment's only content is the committee's run to 1992-12-31, so under the strike-and-insert and until-date rulings its first end is its own date, 1992-12-31 (inclusive). The 1993-09-30 revocation of the already-lapsed parent is a later event."}]
